blockedUrlPatterns.title: Blocked URL patterns
blockedUrlPatterns.description: Sites where AutoDOM may not act. Each pattern is matched against the page's host and path (for example 'example.com/admin/*'). '*' matches any run of characters; matching is case-insensitive; a leading scheme or 'www.' is ignored. A bare domain is treated as '<domain>/*'; use '*.example.com' to include subdomains. Applies to the page a tool runs on and to the destination of navigate/open_new_tab, for every caller, and overrides the user's own settings.
